title: Python Texture Rotation: repeated scaffolds vary before export

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.166 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run is attached.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.166 release completes its deploy run.

claims.summary: The release is grounded in fresh deployed v0.15.165 GPT-5.4-mini Python ZIP evidence that locally regraded 100/A with Texture 95 and exposed deterministic repeated Python scaffold phrases.
proofCommands: rg -n "Fresh deployed v0.15.165|Texture stayed at 95" src/lib/releaseManifest.js release-contracts/v0.15.166.json

claims.summary: Computer Science/Python weekly-assessment repairs rotate broader lesson-specific trace memo, bug-fix, implementation-choice, partner-review, edge-case, lab-checkpoint, and code-review variants.
proofCommands: rg -n "trace memo|bug-fix note|implementation choice|partner review|edge-case probe|code review card" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js

claims.summary: Sparse Course Map fallback rotation now uses lesson and section position so a full Python map does not reuse the same assessment stem every few sections.
proofCommands: rg -n "variantIndex = .*sections.length|varies sparse Python section fallback" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js

claims.summary: Python support-text repairs replace repeated generic phrases with varied prompts, and assignment-title repair keeps colon-delimited task details out of titles.
proofCommands: rg -n "observable behavior|fresh run|boundary case|design choice|working Python behavior|replace\(/:\\s\+\.\+\$/" src/lib/deliverableReadiness.js src/lib/packageFinalizer.js tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js src/lib/__tests__/packageFinalizer.test.js

claims.summary: A 12-week, 3-section Python regression proves repeated GPT-style assessment scaffolds are repaired into at least ten distinct weekly-assessment variants before graph/export derivation.
proofCommands: rg -n "12-week, 3-section|uniqueAssessments.size|predict output and explain the state change" tests/v0141-phase1-finalizer.test.js docs/V0.15.166_PYTHON_TEXTURE_ROTATION_ROADMAP.md
